hour_view: Twelve five-minute bins, as in the original charts; no additional historical context.
five_minute_view: One completed five-minute bin, scored when that bin closes.
service_definition: Original flow protocol plus mutually exclusive DNS, web, remote-admin or other service category from prepared features. No raw port or address is a predictor.
partition_effect: Peer/service views separate traffic by counterpart and service; this adds partition information and changes the example granularity. It is not a pure image-versus-text ablation.
population: All nonempty observed-endpoint windows in original capture-disjoint train/calibration/test partitions. Not a verified inventory of managed assets.
positive: At least one source-side exfiltration-labeled flow in the scored group.
negative: All incident flows in the group are benign. Other attack groups without source-side exfiltration are excluded from fitting but retained in evaluation.

model.sample_weight: inverse number of groups in the parent host-hour

threshold: For each view, choose on calibration only the lowest conservative threshold allowing at most floor(0.01 * benign host-hours) alerts. Use the maximum group score per host-hour; handle score ties conservatively.
common_unit: Capture, endpoint and UTC host-hour. OR all subgroup warnings into that unit, without multiplying the reported case count by subgroup count.
existing_gates: Frozen original-three and full-five clean gates, aggregated from source-flow warnings into the same host-hours.
primary_metrics: new exfiltration-positive host-hours beyond each gate
secondary_metrics: recall on 26 full-gate-missed exfiltration flows within their actual scored groups
group close minus flow completion latency for recovered flows
group byte share of those missed flows
exact feature collisions with benign groups
timing: Only completed flows are aggregated. Full flow bytes are assigned to completion bins. Hour coverage is retrospective case coverage; group-specific delay is measured from flow completion, never from attack start.
expansion_screen: A view must add at least one exfil-positive host-hour beyond the original gate AND increase benign host-hour FPR by at most one percentage point on exposed test data to warrant designing another small VLM comparison. This is an exploratory screen, not independent confirmation or SOC approval.
limits: One fixed seed and model recipe, no search
No new VLM calls or AWS resources in this phase
Do not infer VLM benefit from numeric-model success
Keep all four outcomes even if none passes
No interval confidence claim from one campaign
